sentences.en: She was undoubtedly a beautiful woman when she was young.
sentences.zh: 她年轻的时候确实美丽。

sentences.en: Haruyo is undoubtedly under stress during this entrance-examination season.

sentences.en: Metal cases are undoubtedly tougher, but much more expensive.
sentences.zh: 金属箱确实更坚固，但也要贵得多。
